gui.gensokyou.dialog.title: Conversation
dialogue.gensokyou.rinnosuke.greet:
Ah, a customer. I am Rinnosuke Morichika, keeper of the Kourindou.
Though my shop sits at the edge of Gensokyo, most of my wares are oddities scavenged from the outside world.
Youkai, humans, gods... I have long since stopped being surprised by anyone.
If you have some object you cannot make sense of, bring it to me -- for the right price, I can tell you its origin.
Of course, if it is the kind of object that invites trouble, that is an entirely different matter.
dialogue.gensokyou.rinnosuke.wares:
Curious about my stock?
Yen, gold coins, fragments of spell cards... anything rare enough from the outside world, and I likely have one or two hidden away.
But a warning: prices are fixed, no haggling, and if you break something you pay full price.
The barrier has been unstable lately, and outside objects grow scarcer by the day -- buy while you can.
